prompt:
Output ONLY the complete Python 3 module as a single code block, no prose, no tests. Follow this contract exactly; the owner's acceptance tests pin every rule in it.

Write a self-contained Python 3 module implementing the "tile loop" of a layered render engine with a shared journal: nested tiles that each go through render -> verify -> promote, with digest identity that EXCLUDES the attempt counter, journal tombstones on reopen, cross-job replay, apron staleness detection and upward re-open cascade. Standard library only (enum, json, hashlib). No I/O, no printing, no threads, no classes beyond the ones named here. Tests are appended below the module in the same file, so never import the module by a name such as solution; refer to Loop, TileState and TileError directly.

Definitions:
- canonical(x) = json.dumps(x, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) with default ensure_ascii.
- digest(s) = hashlib.sha256(s.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() for a str s.

class TileState(Enum) with members OPEN="open", RENDERED="rendered", PROMOTED="promoted", QUARANTINED="quarantined".
class TileError(Exception): raised for every invalid call listed below.

class Loop:
  Loop(max_attempts=3, max_reopens=2, journal=None)
    journal: a dict shared between Loops (one Loop = one job). If None, a fresh dict. Exposed as the attribute .journal. It maps identity string -> output digest string, or -> None for a TOMBSTONE (a vetoed identity that must never replay until it is verified again).

  add(tile_id, inputs, recipe, neighbours=(), children=()): registers a tile. inputs is a dict name -> digest string; recipe any JSON-serialisable dict; neighbours and children are ids of tiles already added in THIS loop. A tile with children is a parent, otherwise a leaf. TileError for: duplicate id, unknown neighbour or child id, a tile naming itself, or a child that already has a parent. Every tile starts OPEN with attempt 0, reopens 0, no output, last_code None.

  state(tile_id) -> TileState. attempt(tile_id) -> int. reopens(tile_id) -> int. output(tile_id) -> the output digest once PROMOTED; a tile quarantined by reopen keeps and still reports its last promoted output; otherwise None. last_code(tile_id) -> None or one of "PASS", "VALIDITY_FAIL", "QUALITY_FAIL", "APRON_STALE", "REPLAY". An unknown tile id in ANY method -> TileError, never KeyError.

  apron(tile_id) -> dict {neighbour id: output(neighbour) if that neighbour is PROMOTED else None}, an explicit None entry for every non-promoted neighbour; {} only when there are no neighbours.

  identity(tile_id) -> digest(canonical({"apron": apron(tile_id), "children": [output(child) if the child is PROMOTED else None, in add order], "inputs": inputs, "recipe": recipe})). NOTE: attempt is NOT part of identity; re-rendering after a reopen keeps the same identity.

  render(tile_id, output=None, source=None) -> TileState: only from OPEN, else TileError.
    Leaf: output must be a str and source a non-empty str, else TileError. Candidate digest = digest(output). Snapshot the apron now; record source.
    Parent: TileError unless every child is PROMOTED. output and source are ignored; candidate digest = digest(canonical([output(child) for each child in order])); recorded source "assemble". Snapshot the apron.
    Replay: compute identity(tile_id) first. If the journal maps it to a digest (not None, not absent), the tile becomes PROMOTED immediately with that digest, last_code "REPLAY", recorded source "journal"; return PROMOTED. A tombstone (None) or an absent identity means no replay: the tile becomes RENDERED; return RENDERED.

  verify(tile_id, validity, quality, reviewer) -> TileState: only from RENDERED, else TileError. reviewer must be a non-empty str and must differ from the recorded source, else TileError with no state change.
    Recompute the apron; if it differs from the snapshot: last_code "APRON_STALE", candidate discarded, tile OPEN, attempt NOT incremented; return OPEN.
    If validity and quality: last_code "PASS", tile PROMOTED with the candidate as output, and journal[identity(tile_id)] = output (this replaces a tombstone). Return PROMOTED.
    Else last_code "VALIDITY_FAIL" if validity is false else "QUALITY_FAIL"; candidate discarded; attempt incremented; QUARANTINED if attempt > max_attempts else OPEN. Return the state.

  reopen(tile_id, reason) -> TileState: only from PROMOTED, else TileError. reopens incremented; if reopens > max_reopens: QUARANTINED, output kept, journal untouched, nothing else changes. Otherwise: journal[identity(tile_id)] = None (tombstone, computed BEFORE clearing the output), the output is cleared, attempt incremented, tile OPEN; every ancestor (parent, grandparent, ...) that is RENDERED or PROMOTED becomes OPEN with its output cleared and attempt unchanged (their journal entries are untouched). Siblings, children and unrelated tiles untouched. Return OPEN.

  QUARANTINED tiles are frozen: render, verify, reopen -> TileError.
  height() -> tiles not PROMOTED. done() -> all PROMOTED. stuck() -> any QUARANTINED.
  snapshot() -> {"tiles": {tile_id: {"state": value string, "attempt": int, "reopens": int, "children": [ids], "neighbours": [ids], "output": digest or None, "last_code": code or None}}}.

Keep it deterministic and simple.
